name: 78754 · Austin, TX
findings: ZIP 78754 (Austin) has 119 nonprofit organizations. 60 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 56 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78754 (Austin) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 78754 (Austin) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 56 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
